senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גדל)great, distinguished; (noun) a great man, leader.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 94b:2">Sabb. 94ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ג׳ כבוד הבריות וכ׳</he> human dignity is something great, for it overrules a prohibitive law &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:11">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ מלאכה וכ׳</he> labor is something great, for it honors him who pursues it.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:9">Sot. I, 9</cite> <he>ג׳ ממנו</he> his superior.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:8">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>גְּדוֹל העולמים</he> the Great One of the worlds, the Lord.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22a:1">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּ׳ הדור</he> a prominent man of his days. Y. ib. III, 82ᶜ top <he>גְּ׳ המשפחה</he> the chief of the family; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:8">Yeb. II, 8</cite> <he>בג׳</he> on the eldest brother.
Ib. XIII, 11 ג׳ וקטנה if one of the brother’s widows is of age, and the other a minor; a. fr.—כהן גדול (abbr. כ״ג) Highpriest.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>גְּדוֹלֵי הדור</he> scholars, v. supra; <he>ג׳ ירושלים</he> prominent citizens of Jerusalem.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:9">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ רומי</he> Roman dignitaries; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 23b:6">Ber. 23ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>גדולים</he> (sub. <he>נקבים</he>) the larger functions of the body, movement of the bowels; v. <cite ref="D00985"><he>דַּק</he></cite>.
